# Exclusive Shipping Solutions (Pty) Ltd

Exclusive Shipping Solutions (Pty) Ltd, also shown on this site as EXCL Shipping and Ex Factory, is an A to Z solution for all your ex-factory supplies. We handle it all for you, direct from the factory or farmer to you. We are based in East London, South Africa, and we have direct ex-factory facilities right across South Africa.

## What we export

Proudly South African goods, sourced from the factory or farm. Products listed on the site:

- Brown onions
- Potatoes
- Popcorn
- Apples and pears
- Super maize meal
- White maize flour
- Yellow maize flour
- Yellow corn
- White corn
- Grit A & B, coarse maize grit, 50kg bags
- Brown teff flour
- White and brown sugar
- Chocolate eclairs
- Naks, assorted flavours, 50 x 20g bales
- Noodles, assorted flavours, 50 x 20g
- Energy drinks, 24 x 250ml and 4 x 250ml, all flavours available
- Thai long grain parboiled rice, 1 ton sling bags, 100% non-broken and 15% broken
- Bananas, Angola origin, 18kg boxes

We also source any other products you require on your behalf, ensuring the best quality and international standards. We source directly from the factory or farm and deliver to your doorstep at factory prices. With our extensive national network, we can source almost anything you require. We also handle shipping and relocation (road, sea and air), immigrating and relocation, and customs import and export.

## Markets

We supply buyers in South Africa, Namibia, Botswana, Zimbabwe, Mozambique, Angola, Zambia, the DRC, the UAE and Saudi Arabia, but we are not limited to these countries.

## How to request a quote

WhatsApp us on 0027 79 897 5960, email orders@exclshipping.com, or use the contact form on this website.

We handle orders directly with you. Once confirmed, we draw directly ex-factory or from the farm to ensure the best prices and fresh produce.

We do not publish prices, as each customer has specific needs and volumes.
